lines.say: Niamh, can you work Saturday and Sunday again this week?
lines.zh: Niamh，這週六、日你可以再來上班嗎？

lines.say: Em… sure. No problem.
lines.zh: 呃……好啊，沒問題。

lines.say: That was my sixth weekend in a row. I said no problem, but it was a problem.
lines.zh: 那是我連續第六個週末上班。我嘴巴說沒問題，其實很有問題。

lines.say: I said nothing, I got angrier every week, and I nearly quit a job I liked.
lines.zh: 我什麼都沒說，一週比一週火大，差點辭掉一份我喜歡的工作。

board.cta: 跟主管談排班和加薪・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today you'll learn twelve sentences for talking to your manager.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你跟主管談事情的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today you'll learn twelve sentences for talking to your manager.

lines.say: How to start, how to ask for better hours, and how to ask for more money, without sounding rude.
lines.zh: 怎麼開口、怎麼爭取排班、怎麼談加薪，而且不失禮。

scenes.title: Open the door
scenes.sub: 開口：先約時間，再說來意

lines.say: Part one: open the door.
lines.zh: 第一段：先把門打開。

lines.say: The worst moment to ask is the middle of the lunch rush. So first, ask for a moment.
lines.zh: 最糟的時機就是午餐尖峰。所以第一步，先約時間。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: Have you got a minute? I'd like to run something by you.
scenes.meaning: 你有空嗎？有件事想跟你討論一下
scenes.note: run something by you ＝ 想聽聽你的意見

lines.say: Have you got a minute? I'd like to run something by you.
Run something by you means: tell you my idea and hear what you think.
lines.zh: run something by you 是把想法告訴你、聽聽你的意見。

lines.say: It sounds light and friendly, not like a complaint.
lines.zh: 聽起來輕鬆友善，不像在抱怨。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Have you got a minute? I'd like to run something by you.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: Is now a good time, or shall I catch you later?
scenes.meaning: 現在方便嗎？還是我晚點再找你？
scenes.note: catch you later ＝ 晚點再找你

lines.say: Then give your manager a choice.
lines.zh: 接著給主管一個選擇。

lines.say: Is now a good time, or shall I catch you later?
Catch you later means: find you and talk to you later.
lines.zh: catch you later 是晚點再找你談。

lines.say: You're showing respect for their time, and managers remember that.
lines.zh: 你尊重對方的時間，主管會記得這一點。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Is now a good time, or shall I catch you later?

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: I wanted to have a word about my hours.
scenes.meaning: 我想跟你談一下我的工時
scenes.note: have a word about ＝ 簡短談一下

lines.say: Now say what it's about, in one clear sentence.
lines.zh: 然後用一句話講清楚來意。

lines.say: I wanted to have a word about my hours.
Have a word about means: talk briefly about something.
lines.zh: have a word about 是簡短談一下某件事。

lines.say: Notice I wanted, not I want. The past form makes it softer.
lines.zh: 注意是 I wanted，不是 I want。用過去式語氣更柔和。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I wanted to have a word about my hours.
Part two: better hours.
lines.zh: 第二段：爭取更好的排班。

lines.say: Don't start with a feeling. Start with a fact.
lines.zh: 不要從情緒開始，要從事實開始。

items: ✗ You always give me the worst shifts!
✓ I've closed five nights this week.

lines.say: If you say: you always give me the worst shifts, your manager will defend herself.
lines.zh: 如果你說「你每次都把最爛的班給我」，主管只會開始辯解。

lines.say: A fact is hard to argue with.
lines.zh: 事實很難反駁。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: I've been doing a lot of closing shifts lately.
scenes.meaning: 我最近排了很多晚班（關店班）
scenes.note: I've been doing ＝ 最近一直在做

lines.say: I've been doing a lot of closing shifts lately.
I've been doing shows it started in the past and is still happening.
lines.zh: I've been doing 表示從之前到現在一直持續。

lines.say: A closing shift is the last shift, when you clean up and lock the door.
lines.zh: closing shift 是最後一班，要打掃和鎖門。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I've been doing a lot of closing shifts lately.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: Would it be possible to have one weekend off a month?
scenes.meaning: 有可能一個月休一個週末嗎？
scenes.note: Would it be possible to ＝ 有沒有可能

lines.say: After the fact, make one small, clear request.
lines.zh: 講完事實，提出一個小而明確的要求。

lines.say: Would it be possible to have one weekend off a month?
Would it be possible to is a polite way to ask for something big.
lines.zh: Would it be possible to 是提出比較大的要求時的客氣說法。

lines.say: And be exact. One weekend a month is easy to say yes to. Fewer weekends is not.
lines.zh: 而且要具體。「一個月一個週末」容易答應，「少排點週末」就很難。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Would it be possible to have one weekend off a month?

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: I'm happy to be flexible, as long as I get some notice.
scenes.meaning: 我可以配合，只要提早通知我

lines.say: Now show that you're a team player, with one condition.
lines.zh: 接著表現出你願意配合，但帶一個條件。

lines.say: I'm happy to be flexible, as long as I get some notice.
As long as means: only if. So you say yes, but with a condition.
lines.zh: as long as 是「只要」。你答應了，但有條件。

lines.say: And notice means being told early, not at the last minute.
lines.zh: notice 是提早告知，不是臨時才說。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'm happy to be flexible, as long as I get some notice.
Let's see how that goes.
lines.zh: 來看看實際的對話。

lines.say: Have you got a minute? I wanted to have a word about my hours.
lines.zh: 你有空嗎？我想跟你談一下我的工時。

lines.say: Sure. What's up?
lines.zh: 好啊，怎麼了？

lines.say: I've been doing a lot of closing shifts lately. Would it be possible to have one weekend off a month?
lines.zh: 我最近排了很多晚班。有可能一個月休一個週末嗎？

lines.say: Hmm. Weekends are our busiest days.
lines.zh: 嗯，週末是我們最忙的時候。

lines.say: I know. I'm happy to be flexible, as long as I get some notice.
lines.zh: 我知道。我可以配合，只要提早通知我。

lines.say: OK. That's fair. Leave it with me.
lines.zh: 好，這很合理，交給我處理。

lines.say: No drama. A fact, a request, and a little flexibility.
lines.zh: 沒有吵架。一個事實、一個要求，再加一點彈性。

scenes.title: More money
scenes.sub: 談加薪：拿出證據，問出條件

lines.say: Part three: more money.
lines.zh: 第三段：談加薪。

lines.say: This is the scary one. But asking is normal here, if you do it well.
lines.zh: 這個最可怕。但在這裡，只要方法對，開口是很正常的。

board.kicker: Why should they pay you more?

lines.say: I need more money is true for everyone. It's not a reason.
lines.zh: 「我需要更多錢」每個人都一樣，不算理由。

lines.say: Your reason is the extra value you bring.
lines.zh: 你的理由是你多帶來的價值。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: I've taken on a lot more responsibility since I started.
scenes.meaning: 從我進來到現在，我多承擔了很多責任

lines.say: I've taken on a lot more responsibility since I started.
Take on means accept extra work or duties.
lines.zh: take on 是接下額外的工作或責任。

lines.say: Then give examples: I open the shop, I train new staff, I do the orders.
lines.zh: 接著舉例：我負責開店、帶新人、訂貨。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I've taken on a lot more responsibility since I started.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: I'd like to talk about whether my pay reflects that.
scenes.meaning: 我想談談我的薪水有沒有反映這一點

lines.say: And here is the key sentence.
lines.zh: 然後是最關鍵的一句。

lines.say: I'd like to talk about whether my pay reflects that.
Reflects that means: matches that. You never say the words pay rise, but everyone understands.
lines.zh: reflects that 是「跟那個相稱」。你沒說加薪兩個字，但大家都懂。

lines.say: It's calm, it's adult, and it's very hard to be offended by it.
lines.zh: 這句話冷靜、成熟，而且很難讓人不高興。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'd like to talk about whether my pay reflects that.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: What would I need to do to get to the next level?
scenes.meaning: 我需要做到什麼，才能到下一個等級？
scenes.note: get to the next level ＝ 升上去

lines.say: What if the answer is: not right now? Don't give up. Ask this.
lines.zh: 如果答案是「現在沒辦法」呢？別放棄，問這一句。

lines.say: What would I need to do to get to the next level?
You're asking for a clear target.
lines.zh: 你在要一個明確的目標。

lines.say: Now your manager has to give you a plan, not just a no.
lines.zh: 這樣主管就得給你一個計畫，不能只說不行。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: What would I need to do to get to the next level?
Part four: close it well.
lines.zh: 第四段：把話收好。

lines.say: How you end the conversation matters as much as how you start it.
lines.zh: 怎麼結束，跟怎麼開始一樣重要。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: I appreciate you being straight with me.
scenes.note: be straight with ＝ 有話直說

lines.say: I appreciate you being straight with me.
Being straight with someone means being honest and direct.
lines.zh: be straight with 是對人誠實、有話直說。

lines.say: Say it even when the answer is no. It keeps the relationship warm.
lines.zh: 就算被拒絕也要說，這樣關係不會變冷。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I appreciate you being straight with me.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: Could we revisit this in three months?
scenes.meaning: 我們三個月後可以再談一次嗎？

lines.say: Then put a date on it.
lines.zh: 然後訂一個時間。

lines.say: Could we revisit this in three months?
Revisit means come back to it and discuss it again.
lines.zh: revisit 是回頭再討論一次。

lines.say: Without a date, later usually means never.
lines.zh: 沒有日期的「以後再說」，通常就是永遠不說。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Could we revisit this in three months?

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: So, just to confirm: one weekend off, starting next month?
scenes.meaning: 所以確認一下：下個月開始，每月休一個週末？
scenes.note: just to confirm ＝ 確認一下

lines.say: And before you leave, repeat what you agreed.
lines.zh: 離開之前，把談好的內容重複一次。

lines.say: So, just to confirm: one weekend off, starting next month?
Just to confirm means: I want to check that we understood the same thing.
lines.zh: just to confirm 是確認雙方理解的是同一件事。

lines.say: Then send a short message about it later, so it's written down.
lines.zh: 之後再傳個簡短訊息，留下文字紀錄。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: So, just to confirm: one weekend off, starting next month?
I've taken on a lot more responsibility since I started. I'd like to talk about whether my pay reflects that.
lines.zh: 從我進來到現在，我多承擔了很多責任。我想談談我的薪水有沒有反映這一點。

lines.say: You're right, you have. But the budget is fixed until spring.
lines.zh: 你說得對，確實是。但預算到春天之前都動不了。

lines.say: I appreciate you being straight with me. Could we revisit this in three months?
lines.zh: 謝謝你跟我說實話。我們三個月後可以再談一次嗎？

lines.say: Yes. Let's do that.
lines.zh: 好，就這麼辦。

lines.say: Not a yes today, but a real date. That's a win.
lines.zh: 今天沒有拿到 yes，但拿到了明確的日期，這就是贏。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：下班後的兩句話

lines.say: One more thing! Two things you'll hear from Irish workmates.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！兩句愛爾蘭同事常說的話。

lines.say: After six weekends in a row, I wasn't tired. I was this.
lines.zh: 連上六個週末之後，我不是 tired，我是這個。

lines.say: I'm wrecked.
Wrecked means completely exhausted. Like a ship at the bottom of the sea.
lines.zh: wrecked 是累到不行，像沉在海底的船。

lines.say: And when you tell your friends you asked for a pay rise, they'll say this.
lines.zh: 當你跟朋友說你開口談加薪了，他們會這樣說。

lines.say: Fair play to you!
It means: well done, I respect that.
lines.zh: 意思是：做得好，我佩服你。

lines.say: Fair play to you!
Now let's do the whole conversation. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 現在把整段對話走一次。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: Is now a good time, or shall I catch you later?
lines.zh: 現在方便嗎？還是我晚點再找你？

lines.say: Now is fine. Go ahead.
lines.zh: 現在可以，你說。

lines.say: I wanted to have a word about my hours. Would it be possible to have one weekend off a month?
lines.zh: 我想跟你談一下我的工時。有可能一個月休一個週末嗎？

lines.say: I think we can manage that.
lines.zh: 我想可以安排。

lines.say: So, just to confirm: one weekend off, starting next month?
lines.zh: 所以確認一下：下個月開始，每月休一個週末？

lines.say: Starting next month. Fair play to you for asking!
lines.zh: 下個月開始。你敢開口，佩服！

items: Have you got a minute? I'd like to run something by you.
Is now a good time, or shall I catch you later?
I wanted to have a word about my hours.
I've been doing a lot of closing shifts lately.
Would it be possible to have one weekend off a month?
I'm happy to be flexible, as long as I get some notice.
I've taken on a lot more responsibility since I started.
I'd like to talk about whether my pay reflects that.
What would I need to do to get to the next level?
I appreciate you being straight with me.
Could we revisit this in three months?
So, just to confirm: one weekend off, starting next month?

lines.say: Brilliant! You asked, and nothing bad happened.
lines.zh: 太棒了！你開口了，而且什麼壞事都沒發生。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Take a screenshot, and practise before you talk to your manager.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。截圖存起來，找主管之前先練一次。

board.cta: 打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文

lines.say: I'm Neev. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.
lines.zh: 我是 Niamh 老師。打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文。
lines.cap: I'm Niamh. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.

lines.say: Now I'm wrecked, and it's my weekend off. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 我累爆了，而且這個週末我放假。下一課見，Bye！
